This instance loads paint/checkbox-theme-box: a checkbox with its look, as Chromium's theme draws it: in a box that is not 13x13 a square of the box's smaller side, centered (at half pixels too), its frame 1px, its check scaled; the author's background (colour or image), border, padding and border radius have no effect (border and padding compute to 0, so a content-box size is the box); checked, disabled, a light accent-color (a dark check); hovered: the unchecked frame darker (#4f4f4f), a checked one's accent 11% darker in HSL lightness (lighter for a light accent); pressed: the frame lighter (#8d8d8d), the accent 11% lighter. name: P3/BrowserParity.MatchesChromium/text_line_break_uax14
contract: Each supported browser-parity fixture/capture matches independently generated Chromium pixels and layout boxes at its declared viewport. name: P3/BrowserParity.MatchesChromium/video_seeked_contain
contract: Each supported browser-parity fixture/capture matches independently generated Chromium pixels and layout boxes at its declared viewport. This instance loads video/seeked-contain: A paused video seeked to 0.5 s (frame 15), letterboxed by object-fit contain over a coloured box. Boxes exact (box 0). The frames are the same AV1 decode on both sides; the image difference is the 4:2:0 chroma upsampling of the YUV->RGB conversion, measured on glcore and Vulkan (identical): every pixel over the channel threshold 24 lies within 2 px of a colour edge (the colour bars, the moving square, the frame-index blocks), where Chromium's reference (the headless shell without GPU: the software compositor converts with libyuv, one chroma sample per 2x2 pixels, point-sampled) changes colour in one pixel and the engine's Yuv pass filters the chroma planes bilinearly (as Chromium's GPU compositor does), blending the edge over 1-2 pixels. Away from edges the difference is at most 10 per channel (the engine reproduces the clip's source colours exactly, e.g. bar (191, 191, 0); Chromium gives (191, 191, 9)). The override is the measured bad share and cluster, the channel threshold is the default.
